description: This Kotlin source file defines the class `A2UIHandler`, which manages interactions between an Android application and a UI component called A2UI. The class provides methods for URL resolution, readiness checks, message decoding, and applying messages to the A2UI component, using a CanvasController for executing JavaScript and functions for URL provision.

classes.name: A2UIHandler
classes.description: Manages communication and interaction with the A2UI system within an Android app, including URL resolution, readiness checks, message decoding, and message application.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if the given URL is a trusted canvas action URL.

methods.name: resolveA2uiHostUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the A2UI host URL based on provided node and operator URLs.

methods.name: ensureA2uiReady
methods.description: Checks if the A2UI is ready, attempting multiple times, and navigates to the URL if necessary.

methods.name: decodeA2uiMessages
methods.description: Decodes messages sent from A2UI in JSON format, validating structure and content.

methods.name: validateA2uiV0_8
methods.description: Validates individual A2UI message objects against expected structure for version 0.8.

methods.name: a2uiApplyMessagesJS
methods.description: Constructs JavaScript code to apply messages to the A2UI host within the web context.
